summary: Studio City Company Limited redeemed US$153,579,000 of its 7.000% senior secured notes due 2027, representing 43.9% of the initial aggregate principal. The redemption closed on June 5, 2026, and all redeemed notes were cancelled, leaving no notes outstanding. The filing is a Form 6-K disclosing the redemptive action, which is the US equivalent of a Singapore Exchange Rule 324(1) disclosure. This is a debt redemption, not a shareholder capital return; the issuer used cash to retire debt. Watch for any impact on leverage or future financing needs; no risk-arb angle as this is not an equity event.
